description:
Job description

Você busca um lugar para aprender e contribuir? Venha fazer parte do time Leo Madeiras.

A Leo Madeiras é uma das maiores distribuidoras de produtos e serviços para marcenaria do Brasil, que valoriza as pessoas e oferece oportunidades de aprendizado, independentemente de sua condição física, mental, social, idade, etnia, identidade de gênero, credo ou orientação sexual. Para nós, o mais importante é que seu perfil esteja alinhado aos nossos princípios e cultura.

A LMP (Leo Meios de Pagamento, empresa 100% da Leo Madeiras) tem a missão de trazer prosperidade e entregar soluções financeiras de excelência para o ecossistema da marcenaria. Para nos ajudar com essa missão, estamos buscando profissionais para compor o nosso time e contribuir com a evolução dessa frente de grande potencial estratégico para a Leo.

Estamos em busca de um talento que gostaria de nos ajudar na nossa missão e jornada, se identificou? Venha Ser Leo!


Main responsibilities

Estamos em busca de um Product Owner experiente para liderar o desenvolvimento e a evolução de nossos Produtos Financeiros, com foco em adquirência e sub-adquirência. O profissional será responsável por definir a visão do produto, alinhar os stakeholders e garantir que a equipe de desenvolvimento, seja interna ou externa, entregue valor consistente a cada sprint.

Este papel é fundamental para a criação de soluções de pagamentos inovadoras, atendendo tanto clientes B2B quanto B2C, com o objetivo de gerar resultados significativos e impactantes para a empresa. O Product Owner será co-responsável pelos resultados dos produtos sob sua gestão, assegurando que as necessidades do mercado e dos clientes sejam atendidas de forma eficaz e eficiente.

Sobre seu papel no time:

  • Desenvolver e executar a estratégia de produtos financeiros, alinhada aos objetivos da empresa e necessidades dos clientes.
  • Comunicar a visão do produto e planos estratégicos para as equipes internas.
  • Aprovar e desenvolver novos produtos e melhorias, colaborando com as equipes de engenharia, TI e marketing.
  • Atuar como ponto de referência entre as equipes de desenvolvimento, negócios, operações e stakeholders.
  • Priorizar o backlog do produto com base no valor de negócio, impacto no cliente e viabilidade técnica.
  • Conduzir o desenvolvimento ágil (Scrum/Kanban) e metodologias tradicionais (PMO), conforme necessário.
  • Analisar a viabilidade e desempenho dos produtos, identificando melhorias e lacunas no portfólio.
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre tendências e regulamentações do setor de adquirência e meios de pagamento.
  • Treinar equipes de vendas e suporte sobre os produtos financeiros.
  • Monitorar KPIs de desempenho e adoção dos produtos, propondo melhorias contínuas e ajustando a estratégia conforme necessário.
  • Liderar testes e validações de novas funcionalidades, buscando feedback para otimizar o produto.

Requirements and skills

  • Experiência como Product Owner ou em cargos similares.
  • Conhecimento do mercado de adquirência e meios de pagamento (POS, gateways, antifraude, etc).
  • Habilidade em priorizar demandas com base em dados e estratégia.
  • Conhecimento em gestão de projetos e metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de produto e backlog (JIRA, Trello) e design de processos (Miro, Figma, etc).
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação com equipes técnicas e stakeholders.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em ambientes dinâmicos e multifuncionais, focando em resultados.

Elaborar programas educativos e de atendimento médico-preventivo, voltado para a comunidade em geral; Realizar as cirurgias ortopédicas da urgência/emergência e eletivas; Responsabilizar-se pelo paciente politraumatizado quando não houver médicos de outra especialidade; Encaminhar pacientes de risco aos serviços de maior complexidade para tratamento e/ou internação hospitalar (caso indicado); Estabelecer contato com a Central de Regulação Médica para os encaminhamentos quando necessário; Responsabilizar-se pelas internações, cirurgias, acompanhamento pós cirúrgico, retirada de gesso e curativos dos pacientes atendidos pelo Ambulatório; Zelar pela manutenção e ordem dos materiais, equipamentos e locais de trabalho; Apoiar e propiciar condições para aquisição de conhecimentos no campo profissional de estagiários e/ou residentes nas atividades assistenciais sob sua responsabilidade, quando solicitado e conforme avaliação junto ao gestor imediato; Observar o cumprimento dos aspectos éticos envolvidos na assistência ao usuário, quando os espaços de atendimento e a realização de procedimentos envolva a participação de estagiários, pesquisadores e/ou residentes; Participar das oportunidades de formação e desenvolvimento ofertadas como contrapartida pelas instituições de ensino; Realizar as atividades de área/setor, seguindo as determinações do Gestor imediato e padronizações da Instituição.



Main responsibilities

Realizar exames médicos, diagnósticos, prescrever e ministrar tratamentos para as diversas patologias relacionadas a ossos e traumas, como fraturas, torções e luxações, tumores ósseos, pé chato, osteoartrose e deformidades da coluna; emitir laudos e pareceres, entre outras atividades pertinentes a função.

Rain is the fastest-growing earned wage access (EWA) fintech in the U.S., serving 2.5 million employees and backed by top investors like QED and Prosus.

We've raised nearly $400M in funding—including the largest Series A in fintech history—and just closed our Series B to fuel our next stage of hypergrowth. We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated DevOps Engineer to join our innovative and fast-paced team.

This role offers the opportunity to design, deploy, and manage scalable, cloud-native infrastructure to support modern applications.

As a DevOps Engineer, you will work with cutting-edge tools and technologies, ensuring seamless integration and deployment for our microservices architecture. If you thrive in environments focused on automation, scalability, and observability, this is the perfect role for you!

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Infrastructure Automation: Design and implement infrastructure as code (IaC) using Terraform and Terragrunt. Automate provisioning and deployment of AWS resources to ensure high availability and scalability.
  2. Microservices Deployment: Build and manage containerized applications using Kubernetes with Helm for package management. Support and enhance microservices developed in Go (Golang).

  4. Monitoring and Observability: Set up and maintain observability stacks using tools like Grafana, Prometheus, and Datadog. Monitor system health and performance, proactively identifying and resolving bottlenecks.
  5. Collaboration and Support: Collaborate with development and QA teams to ensure efficient application lifecycle management. Document processes, workflows, and playbooks for effective knowledge sharing.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • Proven experience with Kubernetes in production environments, including deploying and scaling applications.
  • Strong expertise in Terraform and Terragrunt for IaC.
  • Hands-on experience with GitLab CI/CD for building and managing pipelines.
  • Deep understanding of cloud infrastructure, preferably AWS.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools like Grafana, Prometheus, and Datadog.
  • Familiarity with configuration management tools (e.g., Helm) and secure application deployment practices.
  • Public Cloud provider certifications in AWS & or Kubernetes (Nice-to-Have).

Nice-to-Have Skills:

  • Experience with SRE practices and incident management workflows.
  • Proficiency in developing and deploying microservices, especially with Go (Golang).
  • Familiarity with multi-environment infrastructure setups and best practices.
  • Knowledge of database systems like PostgreSQL.
  • Experience with load balancing and auto-scaling in cloud-native environments.

description:
Legal Consultant

  • Location: Sao Paulo, Brazil
  • Date Posted: 9th May 2025
In the words of one of our senior clients recently…
“Market Research has changed more in the past 3 years, than in the previous 40”.

System1 is the leading global Marketing decision making platform. We help brands measure and understand whether their marketing works. Predictive technology is our passion, but our focus is very much human. We understand the power of emotion and capture the nuances of human behaviour to power data-driven decisions. We want to drive change and rewire behaviours, envisioning a world where our pioneering methodologies are embedded in the workflows of every marketing decision-maker. We are also who we are because of our people. So, if you share our enthusiasm, are ambitious, creative, and highly motivated, then we’d love to hear from you! Join the System1 team to continue to help us remove the guesswork for marketeers everywhere, as well as secure our growth, ambition, and success.

Becoming part of the team
With 10 Global Offices and over 150 employees, System1 is a fast-changing business. With exceptional IP, technological advantage and a world-class team we are very well positioned for rapid growth. Central to this is our people. We need to hire the right people, into the right roles, at the right time.
We are looking for a legal professional with 3–5 years of in-house experience who is looking for a long-term opportunity in a dynamic, global environment. Based in Brazil, you will work on legal matters that span multiple jurisdictions, engaging with teams across different regions. The core of the role focuses on commercial contracts with both clients and suppliers, but the scope may evolve to include broader legal areas depending on your experience and interests.
What will you be doing?
  • Draft, review, and negotiate a wide range of commercial contracts with international clients and vendors
  • Provide practical legal advice to internal stakeholders across business functions and geographies
  • Collaborate with colleagues in Europe, the US, and other regions to ensure consistent legal standards and contract processes
  • Manage legal queries related to contract terms, risk, and compliance
  • Support local legal needs in Brazil as required, including corporate governance, regulatory filings, or employment law matters
  • Contribute to legal initiatives in areas such as data protection, insurance, and compliance, depending on experience
  • Help refine legal processes and documentation as we grow and expand our global footprint

You need to be this kind of person:
  • Meticulous and process driven and focused on results
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Organised, proactive with a positive can-do attitude
  • Ability to be a self-starter but also be a team player
  • Ability to demonstrate our values: Customer commitment, Creativity, Collaboration & Determination!

You need to have the following:
  • Law degree and bar qualification in Brazil
  • 3–5 years of legal experience, including at least some in-house work
  • Strong experience handling commercial contracts and advising business stakeholders
  • Excellent written and spoken English, with confidence communicating across cultures and functions
  • Comfortable working on cross-border matters and juggling varied legal topics
  • Proactive and mature approach to work, with high attention to detail
  • Enthusiastic about being part of a small, supportive team with a long-term mindset

Nice to Have:
  • Experience in marketing, technology, or digital services
  • Knowledge of data protection, insurance, or international compliance frameworks
  • Familiarity with legal operations or process improvement

Benefits
We offer a competitive salary and bonus scheme. Our people are important to us, and we understand that each person has a life outside of work and we therefore offer flexible working arrangements (Hybrid) aiming to suit your needs. We also offer several wellbeing resources such as “de-clutter” afternoons for your personal and professional needs.
We encourage learning and offer education reimbursement opportunities.
We have recognition schemes, and regular socials, including summer and winter parties!
We welcome applicants from all diverse communities and encourage our candidates to ask us about reasonable adjustments that we may be able to make to support through our recruitment process and while in post .

Paixão pelo CLIENTE - Sem cliente, não há Ligga. Trabalhamos para que todos os clientes (internos e externos) tenham sempre uma experiência surpreendente.

Orientação para RESULTADO - Somos orientados pelas nossas entregas. Muitas, rápidas e ótimas - mesmo que pequenas buscamos resultados todos os dias!

Crença na TRANSPARÊNCIA - Abrimos caixas, dados e ideias. Guardar informações é um erro inaceitável.

Incentivamos o PROTAGONISMO - Desafios são oportunidades para quem quer brilhar. Se há um problema, pegue pra você e resolva.

Criamos CONEXÃO - Não existe um indivíduo sem um todo. Não existe uma área sem uma empresa. Levantamos e criamos contato próximo e autêntico com nossos colegas.

Buscamos uma TRANSFORMAÇÃO - Muito mais que inovar, queremos ser um marco na vida dos nossos clientes, fornecedores e funcionários. Entendemos que repetir as mesmas fórmulas não irá iniciar a transformação.

Se identificou? Venha fazer parte desse time!

Pioneira em popularizar o acesso à fibra no país, a Ligga Telecom é resultado da composição de 4 empresas com atuação no Paraná, São Paulo e Mato Grosso, são elas: Ligga Telecom, Horizons, Nova Fibra e Sercomtel.

Com novos investimentos e crescimento, precisamos de um time forte na frente das conexões que mais importam: aquelas com nossos clientes!

Este é nosso banco de talentos para captar, com ainda mais assertividade e agilidade, os melhores candidatos para os nossos times comerciais em todo o Paraná :

  • B2B: Vendas corporativas e Carrier/ISPs;
  • B2C: Lojas, Canal Direto e demais frentes com nosso cliente final;
  • Governo: Vendas a partir de processos licitatórios aos órgãos governamentais;
  • Pré-Vendas: Time técnico, que apoiará nossos vendedores a estruturarem as melhores propostas aos clientes!

Buscamos talentos que tenham tanto vivência quanto interesse em posições de vendas ou suporte ao time comercial!

  • Atualize seus contatos: assim que abrirem vagas condizentes com seu perfil, nosso time irá acioná-lo pelo WhatsApp - então, garanta que seus contatos estejam bem preenchidos com o código de área correto.

Incentivamos a diversidade! Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas a profissionais com deficiência ou reabilitados.

Aqui na Ligga, nos preocupamos com você e seu bem-estar. Fique por dentro dos nossos benefícios:

Além disso, promovemos uma cultura que valoriza:

  • Oportunidade de trabalhar e se desenvolver em uma empresa em crescimento, uma das maiores do Paraná em sua área.

Quem somos nós!

Ligga aproxima, une e conecta você à tecnologia da fibra óptica e ao 5G.

Atuamos no Paraná e em breve expandiremos pelo Brasil, oferecendo soluções residenciais e empresariais. title: Technical Product Senior Analyst
description:
EBANX is the leading payment platform connecting global companies with customers from the fastest-growing digital markets in the world.

Since the beginning of our journey, we have had one mission: toprovide global access for everyone. We believe that transforming challenges into opportunities and making the impossible part of the journey is crucial! That's precisely why we created a payment technology that builds bridges between people and businesses every day in 29 rising markets across the globe.

We call ourselves ebankers, we are global thinkers, we value diversity, we foster creativity and we work hard to connect businesses and people worldwide through payments. Let's make history together?

We are looking for a talented Technical Product Senior Analyst who will be working on managing our Products in different regions and countries.

Are you passionate about technology and helping users and merchants thrive? Do you have a knack for understanding their needs and translating them into actionable product strategies? If so, this Product role is the perfect fit for you!

In this position, you'll play a key role in driving the success of our innovative products. You'll bridge the gap between users, merchants, engineering, operations and design teams, ensuring our products not only meet but exceed their expectations.

Besides conquering the world, your activities will be:

  • Become a product expert: Gain a deep understanding of our product line and its core solutions, its features, and functionalities for all stakeholders;
  • The voice of the user/merchant: Conduct user research, analyze user/merchant feedback, and identify pain points;
  • Product champion: Advocate for the user/merchant and translate their needs into product requirements and roadmaps;
  • Competitive edge: Stay up-to-date on industry trends and competitor landscape to inform product strategy for both users and merchants;
  • Content creation: Develop compelling product content (e.g., user guides, demos) for various audiences (users and merchants);
  • Collaboration is key: Work closely with other teams across the organization (Engineering, Finance, Operations, Regulatory, Design, Marketing, etc.) to guarantee excellent and efficient deliveries that bring our products to life;
  • Launch and beyond: Participate in product launches and ensure smooth post-launch transitions for users and merchants;

What’s mandatory:

  • Experienced as a Product professional in which you have shipped products successfully – from ideation to launch will be considered a differential;
  • Understand our business and the market that we are in;
  • Experience with Product management and the whole Product Development Cycle;
  • High levels of empathy with our product users and ability to understand their product needs;
  • Analytics, problem-solving, prioritization, good time management and user experience skills;
  • A strong sense of urgency and ownership;
  • Great sense of business needs;
  • Ability to function independently and in a team environment;
  • Great communication skills in Portuguese and English;
  • Passionate about being part of something special, and for building and delivering great products that deliver value to our customers and make a difference;
  • A quick learner, passionate about your work and driven to get things done.

What else would we like to see?

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Technology, or a related field;
  • Ability to translate complex ideas into clear and intuitive product strategies;
  • Multilingual abilities, especially in markets relevant to the company - Portuguese, English, Spanish and Chinese Mandarin;
  • Adaptation: demonstrates agility in adapting to changes, ensuring continuous alignment with evolving business needs, strategic moves, and market conditions;
  • Familiarity with tools and systems such as product management softwares, and data visualization/monitoring tools such as Tableau, and Kibana;
  • Teamwork: Collaborative creativity to find the most elegant solutions;
  • Legacy Respect: Learn from what works;
  • Pragmatism: Value results and practical solutions;
  • Quality First: Prioritize quality in every product decision;
  • Technical background is a plus;
  • Knowledge of payments ecosystem.

EBANX offers:

  • Spanish, English, and Portuguese classes;
  • WAVES - Program of goals and results (variable compensation);
  • EBANX Play - Wellness (Gympass, e-Sports, SESC );
  • EBANX Education: financial support for undergraduate, graduate, and MBA programs so you can develop important skills for your career;
  • EBANX Skills: budget for workshops and courses;
  • EBANX Flexible: Birthday Day Off;
  • Semi-flexible hours (8 hours a day - Monday to Friday);
  • EBANX Family: Daycare assistance, extended leave for caregivers and support program for children and pregnant women;
  • EBANX Health: Health and Dental Insurance, with subsidy for dependents and medicine subsidy for ebankers;
  • Life Insurance: Life Insurance 100% paid by EBANX;
  • Blue Club: Exclusive discount for ebankers in bakeries, restaurants, courses, electronics stores, and more!

Follow us on LinkedIn and check out our Instagram to learn more about the #ebanxlife.

title: Senior Software Developer - Sao Paulo
description:
We're quickly growing and super excited for you to join us!

About Topsort

Today, Topsort has 5 major hubs worldwide, and employees in 13+ countries, including Menlo Park, Boston, Santiago Chile, Sao Paulo Brazil, Barcelona Spain, and Sydney Australia. We are a truly global company that was born in the pandemic that’s had rapid growth since out of a genius product, a customer-first mentality, and a hardworking team of talented individuals. Since our founding in 2021, we’ve gained customers in retail, marketplaces, and delivery apps in 40+ countries and quickly approaching the #1 position in the industry.

Do you enjoy a fast-paced environment? Do you like seeing your work create real-time impact, being part of a rocket ship from the very beginning? Let’s do the unimaginable - let’s make ads clean and cool again, with AI and modern technology.

What it’s like to work at Topsort

Our team is all about straightforward communication, embracing feedback without taking it personally, and fostering a super collaborative environment. It’s a sports team that’s hyper focused on winning, collaborative internally, and competitive externally - never the other way around. We thrive on working in the open, lifting each other up, and getting things done with a sense of urgency. We're the kind of team that loves making bold choices, sharing extraordinary opinions, and maintaining a 100 mph pace. No endless meetings here – if it can be done today, we're all about getting it done today.

What is this role like?

As aSenior Software Developer at Topsort you will build back-end services, APIs, and front-end experiences to support our mission: democratizing auction-based infrastructure for all marketplaces. Our first product is sponsored listings as a service. We automate and simplify auctions so that any advertiser, especially small ones, can compete successfully. It’s not easy. We use our game and auction theory expertise; implement real-time, scalable, always-available systems; and build an intuitive, easy-to-use UI for managing campaigns.

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable, high-performance applications while ensuring code quality and best practices.
  • Provide mentorship, conduct code reviews, and drive best engineering practices to improve team efficiency.
  • Identify and resolve bottlenecks, optimize system performance, and ensure reliability in distributed architectures.
  • Work with cross-functional teams, translate business needs into technical solutions, and drive innovation through new technologies and best practices.

What (we think) you need to be successful - we’re open to not checking all the boxes and be proven wrong by outlier candidates as well!

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in backend engineering, designing, developing, and maintaining scalable services.
  • Strong experience with microservices architecture and distributed systems, ensuring efficiency and reliability.
  • Proven track record of implementing engineering best practices, improving development efficiency and maintaining high code quality.
  • Proficiency in Python and TypeScript, with a solid understanding of best practices, patterns, and performance optimization.
  • Expertise in high-performance, low-latency systems, designing solutions that scale efficiently.
  • Deep knowledge of distributed systems, decoupling patterns, and modern software architecture to build robust and maintainable services.
  • Strong problem-solving and collaboration skills, working closely with product and engineering teams to develop new features and optimize existing ones.
  • Work onsite at one of our offices in Santiago or Sao Paulo 4 days a week.

Why it’s awesome to work at Topsort

  • Direct Feedback and Rapid Growth: (96% of Topsorters report )We work hard, set aggressive goals and execute flawlessly to accomplish them. We give candid feedback, push each other to set higher goals and produce more impact by always thinking “how do we do this faster and better”.
  • Be part of an elite and collaborative sports team: We believe startup scaleup is just like a team sport. It's been written in our motto since day 1 that we are collaborative internally, competitive externally, and never the other round around. You are ultimately surrounded by just different people that are all here to help you get the job done and shine as a team.
  • Company Offsite and Industry Exposure: Once a year Topsorters get together as a whole and also meet customers and really spend time to get feedback.
  • Working Equipment and Hubs: our team is global and also centered around hubs, that means you’re welcome to create a hybrid work schedule, and encouraged to travel to other hubs to collaborate. We provide working devices of your choice and surprise swags for special events.
  • Flexible PTO schedule with floating holidays: we encourage Topsorters to take time off and recharge, and respect different cultural norms so offer floating holidays to accommodate the celebrations you’d like.
  • Meditation App, Birthday and Anniversary Celebrations: we like little surprises and remember the key moments to celebrate with you!

Do you sound like the right fit? Let's dive right in!

description:
About Us

CloudKitchens helps restaurateurs around the world succeed in online food delivery - our goal is to make food more affordable, higher quality and convenient for everyone.

We take underutilized properties and transform them into smart kitchens so they can better serve restaurateurs, customers and the neighborhoods they’re in. Every time we launch a new facility we create jobs in that neighborhood, and we’re proud to provide a wide range of cuisines and options for healthy food at an affordable price.

We're changing the game for restaurateurs whether they’re entrepreneurs opening their first restaurant all the way through to your favorite global quick-service restaurant chains.

Our engineering effort spans infrastructure, platforms, and product development, driving innovation and excellence. Whether optimizing systems, building tools for developers, or creating user-facing features, your work will have a direct impact on real-world problems.

We are seeking Backend Engineers who are excited to contribute at all levels - whether you specialize in infrastructure, platform, or product-focused development.

Check our tech blog to find out more about what we’re building.

What You’ll Do

As a Backend Engineer, you’ll design, implement, and optimize systems that power mission-critical applications. Your role will adapt to your strengths and interests, with opportunities to focus on:

  • Infrastructure : Build and maintain scalable, secure, and high-performance systems to ensure operational reliability.
  • Platform : Develop robust APIs and developer tools to improve team efficiency and scalability.
  • Product : Engineer backend services that support customer-facing applications and deliver seamless user experiences.

Core Responsibilities :

  • Architect and implement scalable backend systems and APIs.
  • Ensure high system performance, reliability, and security.
  • Collaborate with product managers, designers, and other engineers to deliver end-to-end solutions.
  • Participate in code reviews, testing, and documentation to maintain high-quality standards.
  • Mentor junior engineers or take on leadership roles, depending on your seniority.

What We’re Looking For

We value diversity of experience and are looking for individuals passionate about solving complex problems.

Basic Qualifications :

  • Proficiency in backend programming languages like Java , Go , or Node.js .
  • Familiarity with relational and/or NoSQL databases (e.g., PostgreSQL , MongoDB , Redis ).
  • Experience with cloud platforms like AWS , Google Cloud , or Azure .
  • Understanding of RESTful APIs, microservices, and distributed systems.
  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications (for Senior Levels) :

  • Experience with containerization technologies like Docker and Kubernetes .
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
  • Exposure to large-scale data processing or event-driven architectures.
  • Leadership experience in team projects or mentoring roles.

Why Join Us?

  • Growing market : You’ll be focused on an $80 billion market that’s projected to reach at least $500 billion by 2030 in the US alone.
  • Changing the restaurant industry : You’ll be part of a team that helps restaurants succeed in online food delivery.
  • Collaborative environment : You will work with a talented and diverse team that values innovation and learning. You will receive support and guidance from experienced colleagues and managers, helping you to learn, grow and achieve your goals, and you’ll work closely with other teams to ensure our customer’s success.
  • Career Growth : Opportunities for advancement across engineering tracks, from individual contributors to leadership roles.
  • Exciting Projects : Contribute to products and systems used by millions worldwide.

What else you need to know :
We believe that people do their best work when they are together. As a company, we’re in the marketplace of ideas and innovation. When you’re constantly innovating, changing how an industry works, inventing new products and processes - and we are doing all these things - we believe we’re better as a team in-person. That’s why all of our teams (except for our field-based roles) are now working from one of our office locations 5 days a week. Looking forward to sharing more about a Career of Substance at CloudKitchens.

Agente Stone - Consultor(a) Comercial Externo | Rolim de Moura/RO

Somos muito mais do que uma empresa de maquininhas! A Stone é uma empresa de tecnologia e serviços financeiros focada no(a) cliente.

Nascemos com o propósito de ser protagonistas na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, servindo o(a) empreendedor(a) brasileiro(a) e transformando seus sonhos em resultados.

Somos a maior empresa independente de meios de pagamentos do Brasil, com mais de quinze mil pessoas espalhadas pelas cinco regiões do país, em um cenário repleto de desafios e oportunidades. Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a flexibilidade, o desenvolvimento contínuo e os pensamentos disruptivos e incansáveis na busca de soluções para a nossa RAZÃO.

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Queremos gerar impacto para nosso(a) cliente, quando enxergamos a melhoria que causamos na vida dele(a), é que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

O maior diferencial da Stone é ser uma companhia totalmente centrada no cliente. E para garantir que o(a) empreendedor(ra) foque no crescimento do seu negócio, construímos escritórios próprios (polos) por todo o Brasil, entregando presencialmente as soluções mais eficazes do mercado.

Nosso time de Agentes Stone está todos os dias lado a lado da nossa razão, os donos e donas de negócio, apoiando cada um deles em sua jornada empreendedora, garantindo total comprometimento em resolver os seus problemas e a melhor experiência de atendimento ao(à) cliente do país.

Como é ser um(a) Consultor Comercial Externo:

Seu papel será entender profundamente as necessidades do(a) cliente e conectá-las às nossas soluções financeiras com muita empatia, conhecimento sobre o mercado e encantamento. Conheça um pouco mais do(a) Agente Stone nonosso manifesto (bit.ly/AgenteStone).

  • Jornada de trabalho: Segunda a Sexta | 44h semanais.
  • Gerenciar a carteira de clientes mantendo um relacionamento contínuo e pós-venda.
  • Participar das matinais diárias para traçar os seus planos, metas e trocas de aprendizados.
  • Entregar um atendimento de excelência ao nosso cliente.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Ser maior de idade.
  • Desejável experiência comercial.
  • Saber se comunicar muito bem.
  • Muita energia e paixão por servir o nosso cliente.
  • Buscar a excelência em tudo que se propor a fazer.

Plano de Saúde e Odontológico

Hospital Digital, da Vitta: médicos, terapeutas e um time de saúde disponível 24 horas por dia, 7 dias por semana, na palma da sua mão

Vale Refeição e/ou Vale Alimentação - Sodexo

Inscrição: Aqui você começa a sua jornada conosco realizando seu cadastro e alguns testes.. Fique tranquilo(a), nosso time analisará as informações do seu perfil e entrará em contato em breve. Boa sorte!

Entrevistas com o time de People: Você terá um papo inicial com nosso time de recrutamento, com o objetivo de conhecer nossa cultura, estrutura e o desafio que está sendo proposto.

Entrevista com a Liderança: Nesta etapa vamos nos aprofundar nas suas hard skills com o objetivo de avaliar habilidades e competências específicas para a vaga. Além de te apresentar possíveis pares e liderança.

Check de Cultura: Nossa cultura é muito importante e está sempre presente no dia a dia! Aqui, você terá um papo com uma das nossas pessoas guardiãs da cultura, com o objetivo de nos conhecer e garantir que nossas crenças, nosso jeito de pensar e nossa visão de futuro estão alinhadas com o que você acredita e busca vivenciar.

Feedback: Uma de nossas forças é a franqueza. Por isso, independente do resultado, iremos compartilhá-lo com você e alinhar os próximos passos.

FIELD SERVICE ENGINEER - MECHANIC ASEPTIC

Your opportunity

Sidel is looking for a Aseptic Field Service Engineer that performs Installation, start‐up, commissioning and test of the Sidel Aseptic Equipment supplied to customer sites. The candidate must perform technical assistance during and after the warranty period, carry out trainings and other after sales services of Sidel’s equipment installed at customer sites. Develop a good understanding of the customer needs to provide objective advice and to ensure customer satisfaction.

Your Mission

YOUR SCOPE
Test and evaluate equipment performance at customer plant, based on technical, contractual and safety specifications
Check all instrument and being capable to parametrize it as will be used during phases of cleaning, sterilization and production
Check and setting all parameters and recipes to perform the correct cleaning and sterilization cycle and get the Combi ready for the production
Meeting with Site Manager, Aseptic Filed Coordinator and customer to organize the Filler and/or Blower progresses
Perform the alarms check with Process Authority and Customer
Perform the Aseptic validation with Process Authority and Customer
Perform the caps and bottles validation with Process Authority and Customer to validate all caps, preforms and bottles
Capable to create Tickets securing the proper follow-up of equipment’s non-conformities
Prepare the job progress chart and technical reports in reference to carried-out activities
Perform activities in line with the Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) securing Sidel and Customers coordination plan rules
Report to his manager after sales opportunities detected on Customer site
Ensure ultimate internal and external customer satisfaction
Ensure equipment’s safeties and protections in place and functionals to the scope
Report to the Installation Site Manager and Aseptic Field coordinator for team site activities

Your Profile

Bachelor’s degree or technical degree in engineering (+2) and/or equivalent experience
Fluent level of English is a must
Specialization in auto-mechanic
Experience in the beverage/packaging industry is a plus
2-3 years of experience in field activities
Electrical or Aseptic technology capabilities are a plus
Spanish, Italian and/or French is an advantage
Availability to travel up to 90 % (Including International Locations).

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
About Us:
At edclub, we are committed to revolutionizing the way K-12 students learn through engaging and interactive educational content. We create comprehensive, high-quality courses that inspire curiosity and facilitate deep learning. We're seeking a talented Designer to join our dynamic team to help bring educational content to life with creativity and purpose.

Job Description:
We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented UI/UX Designer to join our team. In this role, you will design educational materials that enhance learning experiences for students. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of user experience principles and a passion for creating intuitive, visually appealing digital products. You will collaborate with project managers, developers, and content creators to produce visually engaging and interactive educational tools.

This role will be fully remote, as our headquarters are located in Rockville, Maryland, USA.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Create graphics, illustrations, and visual elements for experiences that align with educational objectives.
  2. Work closely with curriculum and content teams to ensure design elements support educational goals.
  3. Ensure a consistent visual style that is age-appropriate and accessible to diverse audiences.
  4. Collaborate with the team to brainstorm creative ideas and solutions for presenting content in innovative ways.
  5. Create engaging animations and motion graphics to enhance student learning and understanding.
  6. Stay up-to-date with design trends, animation techniques, and educational tools to continuously improve content quality.

Qualifications:

  1. 3-5 years of proven experience in graphic and UI/UX design.
  2. Proficiency in Figma and Adobe Illustrator; experience with animation tools like After Effects, Blender, or similar.
  3. Strong portfolio showcasing a range of design and animation work.
  4. Understanding of visual storytelling, typography, and layout principles.
  5. Knowledge of user-centered design principles and how students of different age groups engage with content.
  6. Communicate effectively in English with team members.
  7. Collaborative attitude with a willingness to accept feedback and adapt designs accordingly.
  8. Ability to think creatively and bring innovative ideas to enhance student engagement.

  • Planejamento e organização

Detalhamento das Responsabilidades:

  • Acompanhar o processo ensino aprendizagem, em parceria com a equipe pedagógica, buscando garantir resultados significativos, tendo como foco a excelência acadêmica.
  • Estimula os estudantes a perceberem as próprias dificuldades de aprendizagem (metacognição), orientando-os sobre as técnicas de estudo mais adequadas à sua realidade;
  • Identifica dificuldades de aprendizagem recorrentes entre os estudantes, propiciando a formação de grupos de estudo que possam ser orientados pelos professores;
  • Desenvolve e implementa atividades que complementem o currículo escolar e atendam às necessidades dos estudantes em termos de desenvolvimento pessoal e social.
  • Estimula a autonomia, a autorregulação e o desenvolvimento socioemocional dos estudantes por meio de atividades diversificadas, dinâmicas de grupo e atendimentos individualizados;
  • Promove atividades que valorizem a diversidade cultural, social e étnica no ambiente escolar, ajudando a construir uma cultura de respeito e equidade entre a comunidade escolar;
  • Trabalha, em parceria com a Coordenação Educacional de Inclusão, visando à garantir a inclusão dos estudantes;
  • Está atento (a) às informações fornecidas sobre os estudantes a fim de tomar medidas que evitem a pratica de bullying.
  • Realiza a mediação dos conflitos (professor x aluno / aluno x aluno), tendo como base os princípios e valores institucionais;
  • Promove a discussão e reflexão sobre temas que contribuam para prevenir e combater ações e atitudes contrárias aos princípios e valores da instituição;
  • Orienta e adverte, quando necessário, os estudantes com condutas inapropriadas ao ambiente escolar e que não condizem com as diretrizes institucionais;
  • Busca interagir e integrar as famílias, buscando construir uma parceria saudável família-escola;
  • Auxilia o estudante a identificar seus interesses, talentos e habilidades, oferecendo suporte no processo de escolha vocacional e construção do próprio projeto de vida;
  • Participa, sempre que devido, da elaboração e implementação do Projeto Político-Pedagógico (PPP) da escola, alinhando suas ações com os objetivos educacionais da instituição;
  • Mantem-se atualizado (a) em relação às novas metodologias, tendências educacionais e mudanças na legislação que afetem o ambiente escolar e o trabalho de orientação;
  • Organiza e conduz os conselhos de classe, em parceria com a equipe pedagógica.
  • Participa de reuniões e realiza atendimentos individuais com pais ou responsáveis, em conjunto com a equipe pedagógica e professores.
  • Fornece suporte à administração geral e pedagógica da escola em questões relacionadas ao comportamento, ao desenvolvimento emocional e ao bem-estar dos estudantes;
  • Orienta e apoia estudantes brasileiros e convidados nos processos de intercâmbio da Rede Sagrado, assegurando-lhes uma experiência enriquecedora, alinhada aos objetivos educacionais e culturais da instituição.
  • Realizar outras atividades de natureza semelhante às que estão listadas, relacionadas ao ambiente organizacional, conforme solicitação da Coordenação Pedagógica Geral, visando ao cumprimento dos objetivos institucionais e ao apoio integral ao desenvolvimento dos estudantes.

description:

GIC is one of the world’s largest sovereign wealth funds. With over 2,000 employees across 11 offices around the world, we invest in more than 40 countries globally across asset classes and businesses. Working at GIC gives you exposure to an extraordinary network of the world’s industry leaders. As a leading global long-term investor, we Work at the Point of Impact for Singapore’s financial future, and the communities we invest in worldwide.
Infrastructure
We deploy long-term capital through direct, and fund investments across the capital structure to diversify our portfolio. You will help to preserve and enhance the value of our direct private and public equity investments, working with top management teams and board of directors.

The Sao Paulo team was established in 2015, and currently has nine investment professionals. The team is focused on analyzing opportunities in South and Central America, as well as managing the investments made since 2013 in the region. It is integrated into the global team which operates from London, New York, Singapore and Sao Paulo.

Illustrative investments include Aegea (water and sanitation in Brazil), CART/Eixo SP (toll roads in Brazil), V.tal (fiber optics in Brazil), Neoenergia Transmission (power transmission in Brazil), NTS (gas pipeline in Brazil) and Isagen (power generation in Colombia), amongst others. GIC Infrastructure approaches investments with a buy and hold perspective and manages assets with a long-term perspective. We focus on minority / co-control investments alongside industrial and financial partners and have consolidated ourselves as one of the most active investors in the sector and region.

We are looking for a suitable candidate to join our Sao Paulo team as an Analyst. GIC desires to become the leading long term global infrastructure investor and an outstanding career path is available for high performers.
What impact can you make in this role
You will be part of a team that invests into infrastructure companies with stable and predictable cash flows, reasonable risk-adjusted returns and strong impact to local economies.

What you will do as an Analyst
• Play a central role in growing GIC Infrastructure’s portfolio and supporting existing investments in the region.
• Under the supervision of the senior team, play an integral role in the full deal lifecycle: deal screening, approvals, execution, asset management and, when appropriate, exits.
• Take on primary role in the financial modeling of transactions, deal with senior management, external advisors and banks.
• Play a key part in deal screening and appraisal, contributing to transaction analysis, and helping prepare the documentation to support investment decisions to investment committee.
• Investment focus is likely to be biased towards, but not limited to, the power, midstream, transportation, digital infrastructure and water utility sectors. No experience in infrastructure sectors is required, but the candidate will be required to conduct financial research on public and private companies for potential acquisitions.
• The team operates in a flat and meritocratic culture, empowering staff with open communications and robust challenges. Being a team player and interacting with counterparties in a way that builds on our reputation is everyone’s responsibility.
What makes you a successful candidate?
• Bachelor’s degree from a top-tier university with coursework emphasizing business administration, economics, accounting, finance, and/or engineering. Graduation date between June 2024 and June 2025.
• Previous experience working for a private equity fund, institutional investors, or for investment banks as part of the M&A advisory or Equity research team. Experience in the infrastructure sector is not required.
• Outstanding financial modelling skills are assumed and will be tested. The ability to build models from scratch is required, as well as model review and scenario development.
• You will be detail-oriented with a hands-on attitude to deal execution and will thrive in a culture of high-expectations and personal responsibility to own the investment.
• Strong commercial and intellectual curiosity is a requirement to perform well and advance.
Work at the Point of Impact
We need to be forward-looking to attract the right people to help us become the Leading Global Long-Term Investor. Join our ambitious, agile, and diverse teams - be empowered to push boundaries and pursue innovative ideas, share your views, and be heard. Be anchored on our PRIME Values: Prudence, Respect, Integrity, Merit and Excellence, which guides us in how we make our day-to-day decisions. We strive to inspire. To make an impact.
Flexibility at GIC
At GIC, our offices are vibrant hubs for ideation, professional growth, and interpersonal connection. At the same time, we believe that flexibility allows us to do our best work and be our best selves. Thus, our teams come into the office at least four days per week to harness the benefits of in-person collaboration but have the flexibility to choose which days they work from home and adjust this arrangement as situational needs arise.

We are an equal opportunity employer
As an employer, we passionately believe every individual brings with them unique diversity of thought and perspectives to meaningfully enrich perspectives of GIC teams to drive competitive performance. An inclusive environment yields exceptional contribution.

Especialista em Planejamento | Demand Planner

Com uma trajetória de 95 anos, a Americanas S.A . está presente na vida de milhões de brasileiros.

Nossas +1600 lojas físicas estão distribuídas por todos os estados do Brasil, em mais de 800 cidades, levando nossos produtos e serviços a mais de 40 milhões de clientes em todo o país.

Área responsável pelas atividades centrais de planejamento de demanda e pela sua execução para uma Unidade de Negócio e região. Atua em parceria com o time Comercial da BU para captar as principais prioridades do negócio e lidar com as exceções geradas pelo sistema de previsão em primeira instância e alçada. Responsável pela parametrização das variáveis que impactam a demanda no sistema.

Nesse time, você terá a oportunidade de:

  • Responsável pela execução do planejamento de demanda por cliente, incluindo as atividades do S&OP, como: coleta e execução de prioridades da BU, geração de previsões estatísticas, identificação de sinais de demanda, gestão de desvios e resolução de problemas;
  • Realiza análises e relatórios de resultados do forecast (consumo, alertas de tendência gerados pelo sistema, acurácia e viés da previsão, análise de causas de erro) e faz ajustes ou ações corretivas para eliminar desvios;
  • Utiliza técnicas estatísticas (como séries temporais, regressão linear, entre outras) para construir planos de demanda base, sem restrições. Conduz análises de portfólio sob a perspectiva do planejamento, recomendando otimizações e racionalização de SKUs;
  • Responsável pelos indicadores de performance da demanda, como acurácia da previsão (MAPE), viés, variabilidade da demanda, assertividade de promoções, entre outros, seguindo os padrões da empresa;
  • Responsável pela coleta e correto uso dos parâmetros necessários para realizar o planejamento de demanda adequado (logística, fornecedores, itens).

O que esperamos de você para essa vaga:

  • Forte experiência e proficiência em planejamento de demanda e análise de portfólio aplicados à cadeia de suprimentos, com foco no setor-alvo;
  • Alta capacidade analítica e quantitativa, com habilidade para interpretar e gerenciar grandes volumes de dados;
  • Experiência com modelagem estatística de previsões e elaboração de orçamentos de vendas (sales budgeting).

Será um diferencial, caso você conheça:

  • Conhecimento no Sistema Relex.

OBS: Nossos processos seletivos estão sendo conduzidos totalmente online, portanto, fique atento nos e-mails e no spam.

  • Allya: app que oferece descontos em quase 30 mil estabelecimentos por todo Brasil, ex: farmácia, restaurante, salão, academia, etc;

Nossa marca, amada pelos brasileiros, tem o propósito de resolver a vida das famílias de maneira simples e descomplicada. A integração das mais de 1.600 lojas, presentes em todos os estados, e um e-commerce que complementa a experiência do físico nos permitem a realização de uma estratégia de vendas multicanal e eficiente, com foco na geração de caixa e na rentabilidade. Venha construir o futuro com a gente!

Nosso Jeito:

Nossa cultura é centrada no cliente, e buscamos constantemente soluções para aprimorar sua experiência. Tätigkeitsbeginn: 08/2025 bzw. 02/2026

Arbeitszeit: Vollzeit

Anstellungsdauer: 2 Jahre Vertrag, dann unbefristet

Tätigkeitsprofil:

Das Colégio Visconde de Porto Seguro ist eine deutsche Auslandsschule, deren Abschlüsse von der KMK in Deutschland anerkannt werden. Die Schule wird von der Bundesrepublik Deutschland als Begegnungsschule gefördert und ist von der Ständigen Konferenz der Kultusminister (KMK) zur Abhaltung von Prüfungen der allgemeinen deutschen Hochschulreife (Abitur) ermächtigt. Mit zwei aufeinander abgestimmten Bildungsplänen sind sowohl deutsche als auch brasilianische Abschlüsse anerkannt und möglich.

Unsere freundlichen und sehr motivierten Schülerinnen und Schüler lernen in zwei Kulturkreisen, bereits vom Kindergarten an. So erwerben sie erweiterte Kenntnisse über Werte, Normen, Geschichte und Mentalität eines anderen Landes.

Es wird eine Stelle in Vollzeit angeboten. Das Deputat umfasst 26 Stunden pro Unterrichtswoche. Neben dem Unterricht ist die Bereitschaft zur Mitarbeit in schulischen Gremien sowie Engagement bei außerunterrichtlichen Veranstaltungen erwünscht.

Die Tätigkeit umfasst:

  • Klassenleitung
  • Fachunterricht in den Klassenstufen 5-12
  • Mitarbeit in der Unterrichts- und Schulentwicklung

Anforderungsprofil:

Gesucht werden engagierte Lehrkräfte, die Freude am pädagogischen Umgang mit Kindern haben und über Sozialkompetenz, selbstständige Arbeitsweise und freundliches Auftreten verfügen. Erforderlich sind hohe Flexibilität, Aufgeschlossenheit, Motivation sowie Teamfähigkeit und Interesse am kulturellen Umfeld (Brasilien/Südamerika). Die Beherrschung der Landessprache (Portugiesisch) ist keine Einstellungsvoraussetzung, wird aber während des Arbeitsverhältnisses begrüßt und gefördert.

  • Lehrbefähigung in Fach Kunst und idealerweise einem abiturrelevanten Zweitfach (z.B. Deutsch, Englisch, Mathematik, Geschichte, Philosophie, Biologie, Chemie, Physik)
  • Bewerber(innen) müssen über das 1. und 2. Staatsexamen (Lehramt) oder einen vergleichbaren Abschluss verfügen
  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit digitalen Medien als Unterrichtswerkzeug
  • Überdurchschnittliche Einsatzbereitschaft, Neugier und Arbeitsfreude
  • Teamfähigkeit, Flexibilität, Belastbarkeit
  • Idealerweise Unterrichts- und Projekterfahrung in der gymnasialen Oberstufe

Sie erwartet ein hochinteressantes Arbeitsumfeld in einem motivierten, netten Team.

Die Vergütung richtet sich nach der gültigen Gehaltsrichtlinie der Schule und liegt im Landesvergleich überdurchschnittlich. Weitere Leistungen wie Krankenversicherung, Lebensversicherung und Mietzuschuss sind enthalten. Bei Zuzug aus dem Ausland erhalten Sie eine Umzugspauschale sowie eine Flugkostenpauschale.

Bewerbungsverfahren und Kontakt:

Bitte senden Sie Ihre vollständige Bewerbung mit Lebenslauf, Foto, Zeugniskopien und Kontaktdaten per E-Mail unter Angabe der Position und Kennziffer in der Betreffzeile. Nutzen Sie für die Anhänge vorzugsweise das PDF-Format und senden Sie idealerweise nur eine Gesamtdatei.

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung!

title: LÍDER DE FRIOS - VILA MATHIAS
description:
Job description

Liderar a equipe de trabalho no setor de Perecíveis, definir as necessidades de abastecimento das áreas conforme a demanda, cumprir e disseminar as normas e regras da companhia.


Main responsibilities

• Liderar o setor de perecíveis, acompanhar e identificar as prioridades para reabastecimento de produtos, requisitar a separação de produtos em estoque, acompanhar o abastecimento dos produtos observando se estão limpos, sem avarias, dentro da data de validade e averiguar se foram alocados corretamente no ponto de venda, evitando a ocorrência de rupturas no setor.

• Acompanhar o recebimento de produtos do FLV, verificar a qualidade dos produtos recebidos, acompanhar a contagem e requisitar o envio dos produtos para as gondolas e ilhas .

• Acompanhar assiduamente o prazo de validade dos produtos expostos no ponto de venda, verificar todas as ilhas de FLV, geladeiras e gondolas, observando a ocorrência de produtos em mau estado de conservação e que já não podem ser comercializados e retirá-los e encaminhá-los para o setor de avarias. Na identificação de avarias em outros locais solicitar o envio da mercadoria para o setor de avarias.

• Acompanhar os níveis de estoque, checar diariamente se os níveis de produtos em estoque estão de acordo com as necessidades da loja.

• Observar e solicitar, quando necessário, a entrega de produtos que tem maior venda na loja.

• Acionar a gerencia da loja quando observado elevados níveis de estoque de determinado produto, sugerir ações de promoção destes produtos.

• Anteriormente a abertura da loja verificar a ocorrência de falta de colaboradores, compor a equipe de trabalho, alocando os colaboradores em seus devidos postos de trabalho, fazer reunião diária para repasse de informações e diretrizes do setor e empresa.

• Verificar a ocorrência de avarias, rupturas, mudança de preço e necessidades de abastecimento, checar o funcionamento dos balcões refrigerados, freezers, câmara fria e carrinho hidráulico utilizados no setor, e providenciar as devidas ações para garantir os processos de abastecimento, organização e limpeza do setor.

• Elaborar escalas de trabalhos, distribuir os colaboradores de acordo com as prioridades de trabalho e comunicá-los sobre a escala.

• Acompanhar o registro de ponto da equipe, observando faltas, atrasos e necessidades de abonos.

• Acompanhar o desempenho e medir a produtividade individual de cada colaborador, instruir sobre os procedimentos da empresa e orientar para a melhoria do desempenho. Quando necessário, aplica sanções disciplinares nos colaboradores.

• Atender clientes para dirimir duvidas gerais de produtos, atender ligações especificas do Televendas para informar quantidades de produto em estoque.

• Acompanhar as atividades dos promotores (de fornecedores), verificar a identificação do promotor, orientar quanto aos procedimentos da loja, dirigir o promotor para o local em que desenvolverá as atividades e observar a o desenvolvimento das ações.

• Coordenar a montagem de ilhas de promoção, orientando sobre o melhor ponto de montagem e layout da ilha.


Requirements and skills

  • Ensino Médio Completo;
  • Diferencial: Vivência sólida em Gestão de pessoas
  • Diferencial: Ensino superior cursando ou completo em Administração, Gestão Comercial e áreas afins;
  • Será considerado um diferencial, ter trabalhado na área de Perecíveis, de preferência do ramo de varejo alimentar (Atacado, Hipermercado, Supermercados etc);

Whether it’s consolidating tools, simplifying workflows, or collaborating across teams and time zones, Figma makes the design process faster, more efficient, and fun while keeping everyone on the same page. From great products to long-lasting companies, we believe that nothing great is made alone—comemake with us!

Figma is looking for a Manager, Commercial Sales to join our dynamic team of creatives, engineers, marketing wizards, and brilliant business folks. You aren’t the typical sales leader, and we aren’t the typical design tool company. At Figma we think outside the box, lift constraints that block our imagination everyday and we expect you to do the same. With this role you’ll get in at the ground floor in a fast growing sales org. You’ll consult with our existing customer base and potential customers in driving meaningful relationships that add value to the customer experience and revenue to our bottom line.

Figma is growing and moving fast. Our next team member will have an agile, dynamic mindset, be comfortable embracing change, a true team-player, and love working with our growing footprint of Fortune 1000 customers. You won’t be alone! Figma has an incredible team and you’ll work closely with other groups including Support, Design, Engineering, Product Marketing, Customer Success, and Community. As Manager, Commercial Sales, you will lead a team of Account Executives responsible for continuing the growth of our SMB and MId-Market products. You will report directly to our Senior Director, Sales LATAM.

What you’ll do at Figma:

  • Lead a team of motivated and diverse individuals to foster an environment of success
  • Participate in customer and prospect meetings
  • Assist in continual training and development, including mentorship, hiring and career growth
  • Help shape and further develop sales processes and initiatives
  • Interview, hire and train new team members as we scale the business and company
  • Deliver weekly forecast meetings and advise Account Executives on strategies to help exceed their goal

We'd love to hear from you if you have:

  • 5+ years of sales experience (preferably within SaaS)
  • 1+ years of management or team lead experience
  • Understanding of our technical and competitive landscape
  • Ability to thrive in a constantly changing and evolving environment
  • Exceptional coaching, writing, discovery and presentation skills
  • Excitement for increasing customer happiness and developing lasting customer relationships
  • Proven track record of leading successful and consistent sales team

When our team founded Insider, they not only sought to create a product company but also to build the most socially progressive technology community in the world. Behind all these achievements, there is an exceptionally talented and passionate team across 27+ countries that moves fast and agile, creates cutting-edge products, and focuses on making an impact. If you want to join us on this journey, just keep reading.

We are looking for a Rewards Specialist who will join our Human Resources Team to ensure organizational success and performance. You’ll be responsible for managing and implementing appropriate compensation and benefits applications and strategies for all levels of the organization. We’re lucky to have an amazing Finance & Business Support Team, and now, we need your help to grow it.

  • You have an excellent command of English

Are you ready to go the extra mile to create an impact?

Do you want to be challenged with engaging work every day, pushing your boundaries?

Do you want to be surrounded by dedicated and passionate people who care about each other and the world we live in?

If all of your answers are yes, then you are in the right place.

We work together as a family to build this company. Everyone is expected to act like an owner and grow fast. We are a small and fast-growing team from across the world and keep flat hierarchies for maximum impact. We are energized by broadening our scope of responsibility & horizon, are curious, and love stepping outside of our comfort zone. We know that hard work beats talent - an Insider combines both. We help each other, teach each other, and learn from each other. We believe that world-class performance is a byproduct of an empowered, well-trained, and happy team. We think positively and have a solution-oriented mindset - a problem is an opportunity to be explored.

We provide equal opportunity in a zero-discrimination workplace and not just welcome but also embrace everyone without regard to sex, race, color, nationality, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability status, citizenship, or marital status.

Please follow Insider on LinkedIn , Instagram , Youtube, and Medium !

Joining DoorDash means working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where your ideas can shape products, impact millions of users, and help merchants, Dashers, and customers thrive. These include Online Ordering (websites, apps, kiosks), white-label logistics (Drive On Demand), customer support solutions, corporate ordering, merchant loyalty and rewards, and strategic marketplace partnership integrations. As part of a larger Platform Services organization, this team is poised to make a significant impact by helping hundreds of thousands of merchants across the Americas grow their businesses and improve their working lives in one of the country’s largest industry sectors.

Android Engineers at DoorDash work on building an app that’s used by millions of people and critical to local entrepreneurs building their online presence. We’ve seen significant growth in our codebase and number of developers and we’d love for you to bring a piece of your culture and experiences into ours so that we can continue to improve our processes and architecture. Whether you’re an engineer interested in scaling our mobile infrastructure or building awesome product features, we’d love to talk to you!

This role is hybrid with some in-office time expected and will report to an Engineering Manager.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Work within our engineering teams to build exciting features
  • Improve our code base through continuous refactoring

  • Extend and implement our APIs

We're excited about you because you have…

  • A track record of building, launching, and iterating on Android apps.

title: Senior Designer
description:
Interbrand understands what it takes today to build the world’s most iconic brands.

To support our clients in an ever more complex and fascinating world, we have renewed our commitment to both common global standards and greater empowerment, experimentation and entrepreneurialism.

Interbrand is its people. We are a global team of highly diverse thinkers, makers and collaborators. We are proud of our heritage and often regarded as the university of branding. Over the past four decades, we have pioneered iconic work and invented many of the brand building tools that are now commonplace.

In collaboration with many of the world’s leading brands, we are pioneering the future of brand building. In a world where people’s expectations are moving faster than businesses, we give our clients the confidence to make Iconic Moves that create desire and utility, reshape the competitive landscape and drive extraordinary results.

The Interbrand Best Global Brands study/rankings are resources to our clients and the industry, providing proprietary data and insight for our role as client partner and commentator. We have published 18 books on brands and are often the reference point for university curriculum and professional associations. Today, through our own Academy, we aim to be the most impactful learning environment in the marketing world.

Our Behaviours

Our culture is informed by a set ofbehaviourswe co-created as a business. Ourbehavioursgive us space to experiment, permission to speak out, and a model of leadership that anyone in the business can adopt. Our behaviours are Lead with love, Be Brave, Listen First and Make it happen.We are proud of ourbehaviours. They make us, us.

At Interbrand you will create iconic work that defines customer expectations across the globe and creates growth for all. The Senior Designer is a proven talent who demonstrates both logical and creative thinking. At times, you play a client-facing role on projects and you have responsibility to deliver parts of large work streams.

You are passionate about design, making stuff real and pushing the boundaries of ideas. Someone who understands and is interested in what motivates people in the real world and can apply creativity and thinking to deliver work that makes a difference to their experience.

Thinking and making:

  • Diagnose challenges and creatively solve them
  • Ideate and create impactful and memorable solutions for a dynamic spectrum of clients

Relationships:

Commerciality:

  • Work with client teams to help grow relationships
  • Help identify and create award entries and marketing activity

Leadership:

  • Grow others and actively look for ways to inspire and teach others
  • Accountable for individual actions and responsibilities
  • Look to new places for inspiration
  • Remain optimistic, motivated and focused even under pressure
  • Help maintain balance and wellbeing in the wider team

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

  • 4+ years of branding-related design experience
  • Experience and interest in managing/leading cross-disciplinary teams
  • A strong working knowledge of current design programs
  • Exceptional creative talent (in the areas of brand identity across all mediums)
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong written and verbal communication and presentation skills
  • Solid organizational and time management skills

description:
Sales Trader de Renda Variável (Curitiba)

Nossa história começou em 2001, com um pequeno escritório deagentes autônomos de investimentos em Porto Alegre e hoje somos um grandeecossistema de serviços financeiros, mídia e educação.

Chegamos até aqui com a dedicação de equipes talentosas que tiveram garra,determinação, resiliência e, acima de tudo, ambição de fazer o impossível.

  • Foco no cliente:Somos obstinados em superar as expectativas dos nossos clientes.
  • Sonho grande:Miramos no impossível, acreditamos que ele pode se tornar realidade, e chegamos lá juntos.
  • Mente aberta:Nossa abertura para o novo e nossa capacidade de adaptação são o que nos fazem evoluir e melhorar sempre.
  • Espírito empreendedor:Construímos o futuro com nossas próprias mãos com o mais alto nível de comprometimento e sentimento de dono.

O nosso propósito é transformar o mercado financeiro para melhorar a vida das pessoas. Começamos em 2001, como um pequeno escritório de agentes autônomos de investimentos em Porto Alegre. Chegamos até aqui com a dedicação de pessoas talentosas que, por meio da nossa cultura de Sonho Grande, Mente Aberta e Espírito Empreendedor, tiveram a autonomia e liberdade que precisavam para transformar o mercado financeiro.

Porém, sabemos que o desafio é muito maior. Os grandes bancos ainda possuem 95% do mercado de investimentos no Brasil, mas estamos aqui para romper essa lógica e melhorar a vida de muito mais pessoas. Somos exatamente o que o sistema financeiro nunca foi.

Se você se identifica com esses conceitos e deseja construir algo especial, mergulhe de cabeça nesta oportunidade.

Sobre a oportunidade

Como Sales Trader, você irá atuar auxiliando nossos clientes mais relevantes nas tomadas de decisão no universo da renda variável, levando em consideração o momento de mercado, a visão do nosso time de research e o perfil de cada investidor. Buscamos pessoas extremamente organizadas, além habilidades técnicas e comerciais a fim de desenvolver um trabalho de excelência junto a nossos clientes.

Somos uma empresa em construção, então aqui o aprendizado é constante e você terá pista livre para criar e muitos (muitos mesmo!) desafios. Além disso, você trabalhará ao lado de pessoas diversas e talentosas que irão te ajudar a usar todo o seu potencial e gerar o maior impacto possível.

Alguns dos desafios que você vai encarar:

  • Transmitir recomendações de operações de curto, médio e longo prazo, de acordo com o perfil do cliente;
  • Execução de operações nos mercados à vista, futuro e a termo;
  • Assessoria na montagem de operações estruturadas;
  • Contato ativo com os maiores clientes de renda variável da XP para acompanhamento de posição e atualização de cenário de mercado; (alternativa: contato ativo com clientes que possuam carteira de ações acima de R$ 300 mil)
  • Atuar como referência técnica para clientes e assessores no universo de renda variável.

// O que buscamos

Pré-requisitos para candidatura:

  • Estar habituado em colocar o cliente no centro de nossas decisões;
  • Curiosidade em Renda Variável;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar no modelo 100% presencial em Curitiba;

Desejável, mas não eliminatório:

  • Experiência prévia em mesa de operações;
  • Certificação CPA-20.

“Se te oferecem um lugar em um foguete, não pergunte qual é o assento, apenas embarque.”

  • Saúde e bem-estar: plano de saúde, plano odontológico, Gympass , Zenklub , VA, VR, New Value , seguro de vida.
  • Maternidade e Paternidade: auxílio creche para pais e mães, licença maternidade de 6 meses, licença paternidade de 20 dias.
  • Só na XP Inc.: assessoria de investimento e acesso a fundos de investimentos exclusivos.

Jornada de trabalho com flexibilidade

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função: presencial para frentes de negócio e híbrido para as demais equipes. É importante ressaltar que todos os colaboradores precisam morar na localidade da vaga (nossa sede está localizada na cidade de São Paulo e é onde temos o maior número de posições), já que temos atividades que exigem a presença física para promover a colaboração e os rituais da nossa cultura. Esses encontros são organizados de acordo com as orientações dos líderes e as particularidades de cada rotina, para que nossos colaboradores possam exercer suas jornadas de trabalho com liberdade e autonomia .

title: Senior FP&A Analyst
description:
About Digibee
Digibee is an iPaaS that scales integration workflows while reducing cost and technical debt. Rather than require specialized integration experts, Digibee lets every developer quickly build, test, deploy, govern, and monitor integrations across on-premise and cloud environments using a simple but powerful low-code interface.

Founded in São Paulo, Brazil, in 2017 and headquartered in Weston, Florida, our team is widely distributed throughout the Americas. In May of 2023, Digibee closed a Series B funding round of $60 million that is intended to drive our expansion in the United States.

About the role

We are looking for a highly skilled FP&A analyst to join our team. As a senior FP&A Analyst, you will play a critical role in managing financial planning and analysis activities, providing insights to senior management, and supporting investor relations efforts. This role requires strong analytical capabilities, financial modeling expertise, and excellent communication skills to collaborate with cross-functional teams and external stakeholders effectively.
We offer a dynamic, fast-paced environment with high-level exposure to different initiatives and projects.

On a typical day, you will…

  1. Review the monthly financial statement.
  2. Interact with the investors, being responsible for dealing with their ad hoc analysis.
  3. Conduct financial modeling and scenario analysis to evaluate strategic initiatives, investment opportunities, and business performance metrics.
  4. Develop and enhance financial measurement reporting tools.
  5. Prepare and coordinate internal and monthly reports.
  6. Prepare ad hoc analysis to support strategic decision-making.
  7. Measure and analyze the KPIs, interact with other departments to understand the current scenario, and provide this view.
  8. Prepare financial viability analysis of new investments.
  9. Lead the development of financial forecasts, budgets, and long-range plans in collaboration with functional teams.
  10. Perform variance analysis to assess financial performance against budget, forecast, and prior periods, identifying key drivers and trends for P&L, Balance Sheet, and Cash-Flow.
  11. Prepare insightful financial presentations and reports for senior management and the board of directors, highlighting key performance metrics, risks, and opportunities.
  12. Support investor relations activities, including preparation of quarterly earnings materials, investor presentations, and responding to inquiries from analysts and investors.
  13. Drive process improvements and efficiencies in financial planning and analysis processes, leveraging technology and automation tools where appropriate.
  14. Stay abreast of industry trends, competitive landscape, and regulatory developments to inform financial analysis and decision-making.

What You'll Need To Bring

  1. Bachelors in business administration, engineering, economics, accounting or similar.
  2. 5+ years of experience in financial planning and analysis, investment banking, or related roles.
  3. Knowledge of the main Financial Statements: Balance sheets, P&L and Cash Flow.
  4. Experience in Financial Modeling.
  5. Fluency in English.
  6. Advanced Excel skills.
  7. Excellent communication and presentation skills, with ability to distill complex financial concepts into clear and concise messages for diverse audiences.
  8. Proven ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and senior leadership.
  9. Detail-oriented with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

What is nice to have

  1. Experience in SaaS Industry.
  2. VBA preferred.
  3. SQL / Python.
  4. Experience with investor relations (preferred).

Our perks and benefits

  1. We're remote first, with a flexible working schedule.
  2. Health care and Odonto Plan.
  3. R$ 1.200,00/month on Caju card (for food and meal allowance, mobility, home office supplies, culture, health, and education).
  4. Life insurance.
  5. Child care assistance.
  6. Gympass.
  7. English course: we have a partnership for group classes for R$100 monthly.

Our culture

We believe in a highly collaborative work environment in order to foster constant development and exchange between teams. We encourage learning, sharing knowledge, and using new technologies to create disruptive ideas - we want to create something great together!

At Digibee, we know it's our people who make the difference. We embrace and value diversity and are dedicated to encouraging a supportive and respectful culture in our community.

What does Thomson Reuters Labs do?

We experiment, build, and deliver. We support the organization and our customers through applied research in informational retrieval and natural language processing. Our team is designing the next generation of search technology for Legal and Tax Professionals globally. We drive AI innovation for Thomson Reuters.

Lead Applied Scientists are experts in Machine Learning / NLP, responsible for designing and delivering AI solutions that enhance Thomson Reuters' products.   1. PhD in a relevant discipline or Master’s plus a comparable level of experience
  2. 7+ years hands-on experience building IR / NLP systems for commercial applications
  3. Experience writing production code and ensuring well-managed software delivery
  4. Advanced English
  5. Demonstrable experience translating complex problems into successful AI applications
  6. Professional experience scaling yourself and leading through others, in an applied research setting
